stories.title: HYPE hits record high above $90 as Hyperliquid adds native lending
stories.summary: Hyperliquid's HYPE token climbed to a new all-time high above $90. The move coincided with Hyperliquid's launch of manual borrowing, a native lending feature on its platform, per CryptoSlate and Cointelegraph. Both outlets reported the price record and the feature launch as linked events.
stories.whyItMatters: A record price alongside a new lending feature signals growing activity on Hyperliquid, a fast-growing perpetuals exchange.
whatToWatch: Whether HYPE holds above $90
Usage and borrow volume on the new lending feature
questions: Did the lending launch actually drive the price move, or did it just coincide with other demand?

sources.title: Hyperliquid opens native lending as HYPE hits new ATH above $90
HYPE hits record above $90 as Hyperliquid launches manual borrowing

stories.title: O'Leary predicts $1 million Bitcoin, flags a quantum-computing catch
stories.summary: Investor Kevin O'Leary said he expects Bitcoin to reach $1 million, according to Decrypt. He also raised quantum computing as a risk that could complicate that outcome. The report gave no timeline or supporting data for the prediction.
stories.whyItMatters: High-profile price targets draw attention, but this is one investor's opinion, not new market data, and should be read that way.
whatToWatch: Any follow-up detail from O'Leary on the quantum-computing risk he flagged
questions: What time frame does O'Leary have in mind for $1 million?
What specific quantum-computing threat is he referring to?

sources.title: Bitcoin Will Hit $1 Million, Says Kevin O’Leary—But There’s a Quantum Catch

stories.title: Binance launches 24/7 FX perpetual futures with a weekend pricing system
stories.summary: Binance launched perpetual futures contracts on foreign-exchange pairs that trade around the clock, including weekends, according to Cointelegraph. The exchange built a separate pricing system to handle weekend trading on these contracts.
stories.whyItMatters: The launch extends crypto-exchange infrastructure into round-the-clock FX trading, blurring the line between crypto and traditional forex markets.
whatToWatch: Trading volume on the new FX perps
Whether other exchanges launch similar products
questions: Which FX pairs are included?
How does the weekend pricing system handle thinner weekend liquidity?

sources.title: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system

stories.title: Three-year-old bug triggers $1.3 million exploit, forces 10-day blockchain halt
stories.summary: A software bug that had existed for three years was exploited to drain about $1.3 million from a blockchain network, according to CryptoSlate. The network was forced to halt operations for 10 days to address the issue. The report did not name the specific chain or detail the fix.
stories.whyItMatters: Long-dormant bugs can cause costly exploits and extended downtime, raising questions about how thoroughly blockchain code gets audited.
whatToWatch: An official post-mortem on the exploit
Whether affected users are compensated
questions: Which blockchain was affected?
Has the underlying bug been fully patched?

sources.title: 3-year-old bug triggers $1.3 million drain and forces 10-day blockchain halt

stories.title: Ethereum Institutional backs Ethlabs proposal to cut Ethereum block times
stories.summary: Ethereum Institutional voiced support for a proposal from Ethlabs to reduce Ethereum's block times, according to Cointelegraph. The report did not specify the proposed new block time or a timeline for implementation.
stories.whyItMatters: Faster block times could improve transaction speed and lower latency, affecting network performance for traders and developers.
whatToWatch: Publication of full proposal details
Community and validator response
Any timeline for a network upgrade
questions: What specific block-time reduction is being proposed?
Would this require a hard fork?

sources.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times

stories.title: Crypto stocks rebound after CLARITY Act-driven selloff
stories.summary: Crypto-related stocks recovered some of their losses following a selloff tied to the CLARITY Act, according to Cointelegraph. The report did not detail which provision of the act triggered the earlier drop.
stories.whyItMatters: Legislative developments on crypto market structure can swing equity prices for exchanges, miners, and other crypto-linked companies.
whatToWatch: Further legislative action on the CLARITY Act
Whether the stock rebound holds
questions: What specifically in the CLARITY Act caused the initial selloff?

sources.title: Crypto stocks rebound after CLARITY Act selloff

stories.title: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange and developer over alleged IRGC Bitcoin transfers
stories.summary: The US government sanctioned an Iranian cryptocurrency exchange and its software developer, alleging they helped move Bitcoin for Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: The action shows continued US enforcement against crypto used to evade sanctions, a recurring compliance risk for exchanges with weak controls.
whatToWatch: Any response from the sanctioned exchange
Follow-on sanctions or enforcement actions
questions: How much Bitcoin was allegedly transferred?
Does the exchange operate in other jurisdictions?

sources.title: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange and its software developer over alleged IRGC Bitcoin transfers

stories.title: Bitcoin faces an eight-year rates test as the Bank of England unwinds £368 billion
stories.summary: The Bank of England is unwinding £368 billion in holdings, a move CryptoSlate describes as the biggest test yet of how Bitcoin reacts to central-bank tightening in eight years.
stories.whyItMatters: Large central-bank balance-sheet moves affect global liquidity, a factor crypto investors watch closely as a driver of risk-asset prices.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price reaction as the unwind proceeds
Further Bank of England policy signals
questions: Over what timeframe is the £368 billion unwind happening?
How directly does this affect crypto versus other risk assets?

sources.title: Bitcoin faces an eight-year rates test as the BOE unwinds £368 billion

stories.title: CFTC sends crypto market regulation plan to White House for review
stories.summary: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission submitted its plan for regulating crypto markets to the White House for review, according to Cointelegraph. The report did not detail the plan's specific provisions.
stories.whyItMatters: This is a step toward clearer federal rules on crypto market structure, something the industry has sought for years.
whatToWatch: Outcome of the White House review
Any public release of the plan's details
Congressional response
questions: What does the plan propose for spot-market oversight?
When might it be finalized?

sources.title: CFTC submits crypto market regulation plan for White House review

stories.title: Bitcoin hits $80k hours before weak US economic data was released
stories.summary: Bitcoin's price moved to $80,000, and CryptoSlate noted the move came hours before disappointing US economic data was published. The report explored possible explanations for the timing but did not establish a confirmed cause.
stories.whyItMatters: Price moves that precede major data releases invite speculation, but without a confirmed driver, readers should be wary of causal narratives.
whatToWatch: Market reaction once the data's effects are fully digested
Whether similar timing patterns recur around future data releases
questions: What actually drove the pre-data move?
Was it connected to the data at all, or coincidental?

sources.title: Why Bitcoin hit $80k today hours before bad US data even landed

stories.title: XRPL developers try to prove new lending market can't be drained
stories.summary: Developers behind the XRP Ledger are attempting to mathematically prove that a new lending market on the network cannot be drained by an exploit, according to CryptoSlate. The effort follows broader industry concern over repeated lending-protocol exploits.
stories.whyItMatters: Formal verification of DeFi lending code, if achieved, could set a higher security bar after a string of exploits across the industry.
whatToWatch: Publication of the proof or audit results
Launch date for the new lending market
questions: What method is being used for the proof?
Will it be independently reviewed?

sources.title: XRPL tries to mathematically prove its new lending market cannot be drained

stories.title: Bitcoin rallies after BOJ's 1.25% rate hike, with yen-carry test looming next week
stories.summary: Bitcoin rallied following the Bank of Japan's interest-rate hike to 1.25%, according to CryptoSlate. The report says the real test of how the yen carry trade unwinds, and its effect on risk assets, begins next week.
stories.whyItMatters: Past unwinds of yen carry trades have triggered volatility across global risk assets, including crypto, making this a macro risk worth tracking.
whatToWatch: Yen-carry trade dynamics next week
Further Bank of Japan policy signals
Bitcoin's price reaction as the test unfolds
questions: How exposed is current crypto positioning to a yen-carry unwind?
Will the BOJ signal further rate hikes?

sources.title: Bitcoin rallies after BOJ’s 1.25% hike, but the real yen-carry test starts next week
